processing.split_rule: train/val from official train by volunteer: val = the 4 highest-numbered training volunteers; test = official test
processing.tokens: (N,128,9) -> (N,16,72): 8 consecutive steps per token, step-major (index = step*9 + channel)
processing.normalization: per-channel z-score, mean and population std (ddof 0) over all train samples and 128 steps; float64 then cast to float32

processing.split_rule: train = training-archive clips in neither validation_list.txt nor testing_list.txt; val = clips in validation_list.txt; testing_list.txt clips unused; test = all clips of the separate 12-class test archive
processing.unknown: all non-keyword word folders except _background_noise_; per split sampled without replacement from the path-sorted pool with one numpy default_rng(0) used for train first, then val; n_unknown = round(n_keywords / 8) (Python round, half to even)
processing.silence: n_silence = n_unknown; one numpy default_rng(1) used for train first, then val; per clip: file = integers(n_files) over the name-sorted _background_noise_ wavs, offset = integers(0, len - 16000 + 1), scale = uniform(0, 1); clip = crop * scale
processing.order_within_split: keyword and unknown clips sorted by archive path, then silence clips in generation order (train/val); test sorted by archive path
processing.audio: scipy.io.wavfile int16 16 kHz mono; float32 = int16 / 32768; zero-pad or truncate to 16000 samples
processing.features: torchaudio.transforms.MFCC(sample_rate=16000, n_mfcc=10, melkwargs=dict(n_fft=640, win_length=640, hop_length=320, n_mels=40, center=False)) per clip on a 1-D waveform (10, 49) -> transposed (49, 10)
processing.normalization: per-coefficient z-score, mean and population std (ddof 0) over all train clips and 49 frames; float64 then cast to float32

ids.kind: speaker = filename part before _nohash_ (word prefix of test _unknown_ names dropped; 8 hex digits required; silence clips have none)

validation_list.txt.note: copy of the official list from the training archive (sorted as in the archive)

testing_list.txt.note: copy of the official list from the training archive (sorted as in the archive)

processing.split_rule: train = images 0..44999 of data_batch_1..5 concatenated in file order; val = images 45000..49999; test = test_batch
processing.normalization: pixels / 255, then per-channel z-score with mean and population std (ddof 0) over the 45000 training images (equivalent to z-scoring raw 0..255 values); float64 then cast to float32
processing.tokens: 4 x 4 patches in row-major patch order (64 tokens); token values (dy, dx, channel) flattened in that order (48)

ids.kind: index into data_batch_1..5 concatenated (train, val) or test_batch (test); ranges are [start, stop)
